visual_elements.description: 2D multi-class classification plot on a white #ffffff rectangle with a red #c0392b border. Black x and y axes with arrowheads at the positive ends, no axis labels. Three dot clusters: C1 green #2ecc71 in the upper area, C2 blue #2980b9 in the right area, C3 red #c0392b in the lower-left area. Three straight decision-boundary arrows: red line labeled 'd1(x)' running upper-left to lower-right; blue line (no text label in source) running lower-left to upper-right; green line labeled 'd3(x)' running lower-left to upper-right with a shallower slope than the blue line. Hatched shaded regions separate the classes. Three yellow #f1c40f label boxes 'C1', 'C2', 'C3' placed near their clusters. Four orange #e67e22 boxes each containing a black '?'. Three black '+ve' texts near the green arrow (left), blue arrow (top-right), and red arrow (bottom-right). Thin leader lines from the 'Undefined' box extend into the plot.
Slide number indicator: white #ffffff circle with purple #8e44ad outline containing black number '8'.
Pale green #d5f5e3 rectangular box with dark (black) border containing black text 'Undefined'. Thin leader lines (red #c0392b per the element palette) extend from the box into the plot interior.
Light purple #d7bde2 rectangular box with purple #8e44ad border containing black text 'New Class'.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and the largest text: 'Multi-Class Classification using' and 'Binary Classifiers' in red #c0392b, '[ONE VS ALL]' in blue #21618c. Class labels 'C1', 'C2', 'C3' are bold black inside yellow boxes. Question marks inside orange boxes are black. '+ve' labels are black. 'Undefined' and 'New Class' box text is black. Slide number '8' is black.

recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE BACKGROUND: Fill the entire slide with light gray #e6e6e6. No other background graphics.
2. TITLE (top center, full width, top ~12% of slide): one line, bold sans-serif, largest text on the slide — 'Multi-Class Classification using ' in red #c0392b, then '[ONE VS ALL] ' in blue #21618c, then 'Binary Classifiers' in red #c0392b.
3. SLIDE NUMBER BADGE (top-right corner): white #ffffff circle with purple #8e44ad outline containing bold black #000000 '8'.
4. PLOT FRAME (center; top edge ~20% down from slide top, bottom edge ~92% down, spanning most of the slide width): white #ffffff rectangle with a red #c0392b border.
5. AXES (inside the plot frame): black x-axis along the bottom and black y-axis along the left, each with an arrowhead at its positive end; no axis labels, ticks, or numbers.
6. C1 CLUSTER (upper region of the plot): a tight cluster of small green #2ecc71 dots (exact count not specified in source; render ~12 dots).
7. C2 CLUSTER (right region of the plot): a tight cluster of small blue #2980b9 dots (~12 dots; count not specified in source).
8. C3 CLUSTER (lower-left region of the plot): a tight cluster of small red #c0392b dots (~12 dots; count not specified in source).
9. DECISION BOUNDARY d1(x): straight red #c0392b arrow from upper-left to lower-right across the plot, with black label text 'd1(x)' on or beside the line.
10. DECISION BOUNDARY 2 (UNLABELED): straight blue #2980b9 arrow from lower-left to upper-right; add NO text label (source shows none).
11. DECISION BOUNDARY d3(x): straight green #2ecc71 arrow from lower-left to upper-right at a shallower slope than the blue arrow, with black label text 'd3(x)'.
12. CLASS LABEL BOXES (exactly 3): yellow #f1c40f rectangles with bold black text — 'C1' beside the green cluster, 'C2' beside the blue cluster, 'C3' beside the red cluster.
13. QUESTION-MARK BOXES (exactly 4): orange #e67e22 rectangles each containing a black '?', placed inside the plot at left-middle, center, upper-right, and bottom-center.
14. '+ve' LABELS (exactly 3): black text '+ve' — one near the green arrow on the left side, one near the blue arrow at the top-right, one near the red arrow at the bottom-right.
15. HATCHED REGIONS: fill the class regions between the decision arrows with light diagonal hatching (hatch color/pattern not specified in source; default to thin dark diagonal lines at low density).
16. 'Undefined' BOX (top-left, outside the plot frame): rectangle filled pale green #d5f5e3 with black border and black text 'Undefined'; draw thin red #c0392b leader lines from the box edge into the plot interior.
17. 'New Class' BOX (middle-right, outside the plot frame): rectangle filled light purple #d7bde2 with purple #8e44ad border and black text 'New Class'.
